reading.body:
Google's Council Bluffs campus in Pottawattamie County is part of a multi-site investment footprint in Iowa, but the operator publishes no capacity figure for individual buildings at this location. The facility has operated since 2007 and is one of only three Iowa data centers with any published megawatt disclosure, yet those disclosures remain at the regional level, not the site level.

Iowa reports 52 mapped data center facilities across the state, of which only 2 have published power capacity. This Council Bluffs campus ranks third among published-capacity sites in the state, but without a site-specific figure, its place in the state's 18 MW of disclosed capacity cannot be stated. Google's regional commitment to Iowa includes over $20 billion in cumulative investment and a $7 billion expansion plan that encompasses this campus and a new Cedar Rapids facility.

The facts necessary to assess whether this campus matters to AI scaling are not published. The operator discloses investment dollars and timelines at the state level and grid partnerships through power purchase agreements, but does not publish the megawatt capacity, square footage, or building count for the Council Bluffs site. Without that data, the campus cannot be ranked among the productive infrastructure binding AI compute growth.
